evidence.detail: The class is a runtime-retained METHOD-target Java annotation exposing exactly three elements: a long interval, a ChronoUnit, and a boolean flag whose default is false.
The live plugin manager rs/s/g scans plugin methods with Method.getAnnotation(rs/y/a), converts annotated methods into bound Runnable lambdas, and wraps them in rs/y/b for scheduling.

The rs/y/b toString literal identifies its first field as 'schedule' inside 'ScheduledMethod(schedule=..., method=..., object=..., lambda=..., last=...)', directly tying rs/y/a to scheduled-method metadata.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the runtime method annotation consumed by the scheduled-method subsystem.

evidence.detail: The class is a javax.inject.Singleton owning a CopyOnWriteArrayList<rs/y/b>, an injected ScheduledExecutorService, and an SLF4J logger.
Its tick method takes Instant.now(), computes Duration.between(lastRun, now), constructs the configured Duration from the rs/y/a long + ChronoUnit, and triggers when elapsed >= configured interval.

On trigger it logs 'Scheduled task triggered: {}', updates last-run time, and either submits a bound Runnable to ScheduledExecutorService when the annotation boolean is true or invokes inline otherwise; invocation failures are logged explicitly.
The live plugin manager registers rs/y/b records here when plugins are scheduled and removes records belonging to a plugin when that plugin is stopped/unloaded.

evidence.detail: The class contains the exact surviving toString template 'ScheduledMethod(schedule=..., method=..., object=..., lambda=..., last=...)'.
It stores the rs/y/a schedule annotation, java.lang.reflect.Method, target object, bound Runnable lambda, and last-run Instant; construction initializes last-run to Instant.now().

rs/y/c reads the annotation interval/unit/async flag from this object, compares elapsed time from its last-run Instant, updates that Instant when triggered, and invokes either the Runnable or reflected Method.
